name: Zudo
long_description:
Zudo is building the AI workforce for the $100B+ warranty and extended service contract industry.

Our AI workers automate complex, high-volume operations for automotive and home warranty companies — including claims processing, coverage verification, authorizations, customer support, renewals, and sales.

Unlike traditional chatbots and copilots, Zudo's agents execute workflows end-to-end, interacting with customers over voice and digital channels while taking actions across existing enterprise systems. We're transforming an industry built on manual processes and phone calls into one powered by autonomous AI workers.
one_liner: AI Workers for Extended Service Contracts
